grading: 0 off-intent or violates required domain/date; 1 topical but not useful for task; 2 useful partial support; 3 directly satisfies core intent. Judge pooled, deduplicated candidates using URL, title and snippet only; no provider identity or original rank. Unclear evidence is unjudged, not zero.
primary_metric: nDCG@5 on completely judged top-five lists; query-weighted within family; no global score without representative weighting.
